name: Rhythm Doctor
tags: Indie; Music; Story Rich; Rhythm; Pixel Graphics; Singleplayer; Level Editor
short_description: Save patients with your rhythm mastery! Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game where you heal patients by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music.

name: Dead as Disco
tags: Early Access; Music; Hack and Slash; Rhythm; Beat 'em up; Spectacle fighter; Martial Arts
short_description: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

tags: Action; Platformer; Metroidvania; Action-Adventure; Action RPG; 2D Platformer; Female Protagonist
short_description: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

name: Mina the Hollower
tags: Platformer; 2D; Pixel Graphics; Action-Adventure; Top-Down; 2D Platformer; Female Protagonist
short_description: Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

name: Mixtape
tags: Adventure; Music; Singleplayer; Walking Simulator; Narrative; Soundtrack; LGBTQ+
short_description: On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

tags: Music; Story Rich; Rhythm; Arcade; Exploration; Anime; Female Protagonist
short_description: UNBEATABLE is a rhythm adventure where music is illegal and you do crimes. Follow the story of Beat and her band on the run, in a narrative experience full of big emotions powered by arcade-flawless rhythm gameplay.

name: s&box
tags: Action; Casual; Building; Shooter; Sandbox; 3D Platformer; Game Development
short_description: s&box is a game creation platform. Play, create, and share games, all in one place. Hundreds of games ready to jump into with your friends.

tags: Indie; Platformer; Metroidvania; Exploration; Action-Adventure; Atmospheric; Singleplayer
short_description: Play as android MIO in this mesmerizing metroidvania where you explore the Vessel, an enormous technological ark overgrown with machines gone rogue. Uncover its secrets, enhance MIO's abilities, and save the spaceship and its residents from oblivion.

name: VHOLUME
tags: Casual; Platformer; First-Person; Parkour; Atmospheric; 3D Platformer; Runner
short_description: VHOLUME is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

tags: Music; Psychological Horror; Rhythm; Visual Novel; Anime; Cute; Multiple Endings

Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this ♡♡♡♡ world with your degen otaku-posting.

name: Idols of Ash
tags: Horror; First-Person; Parkour; Atmospheric; Dark; Dark Fantasy; 3D Platformer
short_description: Grapple, clamber and fall thousands of meters down into a dark and ancient place in this first-person horror climbing game. You are being hunted.

tags: Trains; Fast-Paced; Arcade; Anime; Colorful; 3D Platformer; Skating
short_description: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

name: Rhythia
tags: Casual; Point & Click; Rhythm; Arcade; First-Person; Multiplayer; 2D
short_description: Rhythia is a game about aiming and hitting musical beats with precision timing, within a dynamic 3x3 grid system. Use your reflexes to target flying blocks, combine accurate aim with perfect rhythm, and finally master the leaderboards against players who challenge your precision skills.

name: Ratatan
tags: Indie; Music; Roguelike; Rhythm; 2D; Anime; Cute
short_description: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

name: Afterbeat (Project Arrhythmia)
tags: Music; Rhythm; Local Co-Op; Anime; 4 Player Local; Bullet Hell; Level Editor
short_description: A musical bullet-hell where all things beautiful are deadly. Dodge well little nanobot, you don't have much time.

name: MONOMOON
tags: Metroidvania; Puzzle; Exploration; 2D; Pixel Graphics; Puzzle Platformer; Nonlinear
short_description: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

name: Bits & Bops
tags: Action; Music; Rhythm; Cartoon; Score Attack; Minigames; Wholesome
short_description: Bits & Bops is a collection of original rhythm mini-games! Filled with catchy music, snappy gameplay and gorgeous, hand-drawn animation, Bits & Bops is sure to brighten your day.

name: Funi Raccoon Game
tags: Adventure; Casual; Platformer; Exploration; 2.5D; 3D Platformer; Collectathon
short_description: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

tags: Action; Casual; Simulation; Rhythm; Cute; Character Customization; Female Protagonist
short_description: A new rhythm game featuring innovative characters inspired by databases! Step into the role of a "Decoder" with special abilities and join the research at PLATiNA :: LAB to unlock the secrets of the locked data world.

name: Dancing Line
tags: Casual; Music; Rhythm; Singleplayer; 3D; Colorful; Abstract
short_description: Guide an ever-growing Line through a multiple of environments, listening carefully to the music. Tap the screen to make a sharp turn, avoiding obstacles and reacting to the World changing before your eyes.

tags: Action; Adventure; RPG; Rhythm; 3D; Cute; Minigames
short_description: The official hololive rhythm game and RPG -- hololive Dreams -- is now on Steam! Enjoy rhythmical gameplay, park development, and mini-games. Featuring 50+ members and 150+ songs, it's perfect for fans and newcomers alike. Play your way!

name: Terrible Lizards
tags: Platformer; Horror; Psychological Horror; Exploration; Action-Adventure; Atmospheric; Dinosaurs
short_description: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

name: In Falsus
tags: Music; Story Rich; Rhythm; Visual Novel; Anime; Female Protagonist; Deckbuilding
short_description: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.

name: Terminator 2D: NO FATE
tags: Action; Arcade; Shooter; Side Scroller; Pixel Graphics; 2D Platformer; 1990's
short_description: Experience the thrill of Terminator 2: Judgment Day with arcade action & pixel-perfect graphics! In this unique story blending iconic scenes from the movie with original scenarios and multiple endings, humanity’s fate is yours to decide.

name: Goblin Vyke: The Thief Tycoon
tags: Simulation; Metroidvania; Stealth; Dungeon Crawler; Difficult; 2D Platformer; Shop Keeper
short_description: By night, you’re a thief, sneaking into dungeons to steal valuable items. By day, you’re a merchant, haggling to sell your loot at high prices. Master stealth, steal the Demon Lord’s hidden treasures, recruit employees, and expand your business. Rise from a penniless goblin to a black-market tycoon!

name: IGTAP: an Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
tags: Precision Platformer; Economy; 2D Platformer; Management; Automation; Incremental; Idler
short_description: Amass an army of clones to follow your tightly-optimised path. Generate massive amounts of power to upgrade your production and movement abilities.

tags: Action; Casual; Platformer; Arcade; 2D; Cute; 2D Platformer
short_description: The Angel Cats are back! Twin Shot Deluxe is a platform arcade shooter where players defend their homeland using bow and arrows. Take aim at 200+ brand new levels set across four worlds. Play solo or with a friends in local co-op (1-4 players) or competitively to see who will be crowned champion.

Her investigation will eventually lead to a single incident—and the truth behind her demise.
